articles.title: Panthers LT Ekwonu (knee) to miss 6-12 months
articles.summary: Panthers starting left tackle Ickey Ekwonu suffered a ruptured patellar tendon in his right knee in Saturday's playoff loss. With a recovery time of 6-12 months, coach Dave Canales said the injury will force the team to alter its offseason plans.

articles.title: Comeback Bears 'no fluke,' rally from 18 down
articles.summary: Chicago quarterback Caleb Williams came through in his playoff debut, throwing a go-ahead, 25-yard touchdown pass to DJ Moore with 1:43 remaining, and the Bears rallied from an 18-point deficit to defeat the Green Bay Packers 31-27 in the wild-card round.

articles.title: Deflated LaFleur deflects job talk after Pack loss

articles.title: Bears LB Edwards fractures fibula, out for season
articles.summary: Chicago linebacker T.J. Edwards will miss the remainder of the Bears' postseason run after he suffered a fractured fibula in the second quarter of his team's stunning 31-27 comeback victory over the Green Bay Packers on Saturday night at Soldier Field.
